item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00311","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C13","C12","C07"],"selected_candidate_label":"C13","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C13 is a highly plausible direct drafting template. It uses the same compact sequence: identify a section 350(a) bilateral trade agreement and the proclamations implementing it; state that the two governments agreed on termination; recite paragraph (6)'s authority to terminate a proclamation in whole or in part; and proclaim termination as of a specified date. The child also closely reproduces C13's distinctive wording, including “under the authority vested in him,” the title and citation of the 1934 act, “the Government of the United States of America and” the counterpart government “have agreed to terminate,” and “acting under and do hereby proclaim.” C12 and C07 share the same machinery but differ more in their authority and operative
